title: SAP Basis Expert
description:
Title : SAP Basis Expert
Location : 100% remote in Canada, EDT/EST time zone / 100 % télétravail depuis le Canada (fuseau horaire HNE/EST)
Duration : until jan 31st 2026 renewable - 35h per week/ jusqu'au 31 janvier 2026, renouvelable

The candidate must have the following qualifications :
  • Experience in companies with over 10,000 employees
  • 15 years of IS&T application support experience, with deep expertise in SAP Basis operations and other technical areas such as:
    • SAP Basis project implementation
    • SAP Transport Management
  • Functional and technical experience with SAP Solution Manager, including configuration and management of:
    • ITSM, CHARM, CSOL, CCTS, CCLM, DVM, PPM, and other work centers
  • Ability to follow and improve processes, methodologies, governance, and guidelines for key SAP Basis activities, whether performed internally or by AMS providers
  • Configuration, optimization, and maintenance of Solution Manager managed systems and scenarios (CCLM, DVM, CHARM)
  • Development and maintenance of system documentation for all SAP instances and interfaces
  • Experience with the following (as much as possible):
    • SAP landscape design, sizing, and performance tuning
    • SAP system installation, upgrades, and client copies
    • SAP ABAP and Java stacks
    • SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, GTS, SCM, and interfaces
    • SAP cloud applications such as LBN, IBP, IAS, CI-DS, BTP, CALM, Integration Suite, etc.
    • Integration engines such as SAP Data Services, Dell Boomi, and Talend
  • English: required. Bilingual (English and French), considered an asset


Assets:
  • Knowledge or experience with Test Suite, CCLM, DVM, Job Management, and other modules supporting SAP implementation at BRP
  • Experience with:
    • Solution Manager administration
    • SAP functional and development integration
    • SAP Cloud administration, Cloud ALM, etc.
  • Experience in manufacturing/transportation/automotive/aerospace industries
  • Experience in international companies with operations across multiple continents
  • Experience in multi-site enterprises

Job Description:
The SAP Basis Expert is responsible for the evolution, technical support, and maintenance of both production and non-production environments. This includes all SAP platforms, applications, and their integrations with internal and external partners. You will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME)/Level 3 support, working closely with Incident Management, Managed Services partners, project development teams, functional teams, and more.

Main Responsibilities:
  • Follow and improve processes, methodology, governance, and guidelines for key SAP Basis activities performed internally and by AMS providers
  • Monitor, support, maintain, and evolve production and non-production SAP ecosystems
  • Perform EWA (EarlyWatch Alert) analysis and implement required corrections
  • Manage periodic Kernel, HANA, and other component upgrades
  • Analyze and deploy SAP security patches and hotfixes
  • Plan and coordinate SAP-related release updates and upgrades
  • Support multiple SAP instances within the ecosystem
  • Dimension and adjust SAP HANA database performance
  • Monitor performance and perform system tuning
  • Configure, evolve, and optimize monitoring tools
  • Configure, optimize, and maintain Solution Manager managed systems and scenarios (CCLM, DVM, CHARM)
==

Le candidat doit posséder les qualifications suivantes :
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises de plus de 10 000 employés
  • 15 ans d'expérience en support d'applications IS&T, avec une expertise approfondie en opérations SAP Basis ainsi que dans d'autres domaines techniques, tels que :
    • Mise en œuvre de projets SAP Basis
    • Gestion des transports SAP (SAP Transport Management)
  • Expérience fonctionnelle et technique avec SAP Solution Manager, incluant la configuration et la gestion des modules suivants :
    • ITSM, CHARM, CSOL, CCTS, CCLM, DVM, PPM, et autres centres de travail
  • Capacité à suivre et améliorer les processus, méthodologies, cadres de gouvernance et lignes directrices liés aux activités SAP Basis, qu'elles soient réalisées en interne ou par des fournisseurs AMS
  • Configuration, optimisation et maintenance des systèmes gérés par Solution Manager et de leurs scénarios (CCLM, DVM, CHARM)
  • Développement et maintien de la documentation système pour toutes les instances SAP et leurs interfaces
  • Expérience souhaitée avec les éléments suivants (dans la mesure du possible) :
    • Conception du paysage SAP, dimensionnement et optimisation des performances
    • Installation, mises à jour et copies de clients SAP
    • Piles ABAP et Java de SAP
    • SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, GTS, SCM et interfaces associées
    • Applications SAP Cloud telles que : LBN, IBP, IAS, CI-DS, BTP, CALM, Integration Suite, etc.
    • Moteurs d'intégration tels que : SAP Data Services, Dell Boomi, Talend
  • Langue : anglais requis. Bilinguisme anglais/français est un atout.

Atouts :
  • Connaissance ou expérience des modules Test Suite, CCLM, DVM, gestion des jobs et autres composants soutenant l'implémentation SAP chez BRP
  • Expérience dans les domaines suivants :
    • Administration de Solution Manager
    • Intégration fonctionnelle et développement SAP
    • Administration SAP Cloud, Cloud ALM, etc.
  • Expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier, transport, automobile ou aéronautique
  • Expérience dans des entreprises internationales opérant sur plusieurs continents
  • Expérience dans des entreprises multisites

Description du poste :
L'Expert SAP Basis est responsable de l'évolution, du support technique et de la maintenance des environnements SAP, tant en production qu'en hors production. Cela comprend toutes les plateformes et applications SAP ainsi que leurs intégrations avec les partenaires internes et externes.
Vous agirez en tant qu'expert technique (SME) / support de niveau 3, en collaboration étroite avec la gestion des incidents, les partenaires de services managés, les équipes de projets, les équipes fonctionnelles, et autres parties prenantes.

Responsabilités principales :
  • Suivre et améliorer les processus, méthodologies, gouvernance et lignes directrices liés aux activités SAP Basis réalisées en interne ou par les fournisseurs AMS
  • Assurer la surveillance, le support, la maintenance et l'évolution des écosystèmes SAP en production et hors production
  • Réaliser les analyses EWA (EarlyWatch Alert) et mettre en œuvre les correctifs nécessaires
  • Gérer les mises à jour périodiques du noyau (Kernel), de HANA et d'autres composants techniques
  • Analyser et déployer les correctifs de sécurité SAP et les hotfixes
  • Planifier et coordonner les mises à jour et montées de version SAP
  • Supporter les multiples instances SAP faisant partie de l'écosystème
  • Réaliser le dimensionnement et les ajustements de performance des bases de données SAP HANA
  • Assurer la surveillance des performances et l'optimisation du système
  • Configurer, faire évoluer et optimiser les outils de surveillance
  • Configurer, optimiser et maintenir les systèmes gérés par SAP Solution Manager et leurs scénarios (CCLM, DVM, CHARM)

Role: Oracle Database Administrator (DBA)
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12 months+
Work Hours: 3:30 AM to 1:00 PM EST
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: 100% Remote (Candidates can work from anywhere in India or LATAM countries)

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to join our client's team, with proven expertise in managing Oracle databases on Amazon Web Services (AWS). This role requires strong hands-on experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) for proactive monitoring and performance tuning. Familiarity with PostgreSQL and SQL Server in the AWS environment is a strong plus.

You'll be part of a high-performing team supporting mission-critical systems in a cloud-first environment, helping ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, and secure.

What you'll be doing:

  • Deploying, configuring, and maintaining Oracle databases on AWS (EC2 and/or RDS).
  • Using Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) for monitoring, alerting, automation, and diagnostics.
  • Implementing and managing backup and recovery strategies, including RMAN.
  • Performing database tuning, troubleshooting, and optimizing SQL/PLSQL.
  • Managing database security, user access, encryption, and auditing policies.
  • Supporting disaster recovery and high availability solutions (e.g., Oracle Data Guard, Multi-AZ RDS).
  • Collaborating with DevOps, application, and infrastructure teams for CI/CD integration and cloud architecture improvements.
  • Supporting database migrations and upgrades in a cloud-first environment.
  • Participating in an on-call rotation to support 24/7 production environments.

Must Haves:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Geospatial Sciences, Geography, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA in production environments.
  • Strong experience managing Oracle databases in AWS Cloud (EC2 or RDS).
  • Deep knowledge of Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM).

title: Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)
description:
Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)
Brazil
Duration: 1 Year + Possibility of extension
Full time - Onsite

Job Description

We're seeking an organized, proactive coordinator to support a co-managed data center migration from on-premises to the comanaged location. This role will partner with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to plan, track, and execute migration activities, while also supporting ongoing infrastructure and network operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and experienced in coordinating complex infrastructure projects across time zones.

Key Responsibilities
  • Project coordination for data center migration:
  • Assist in developing and maintaining the migration project plan, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate discovery and inventory of applications, servers, storage, network devices, and interdependencies.
  • Support readiness assessments, migration runbooks, fallback plans, and post-migration validation.
  • Track risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID), and drive mitigation or escalation.
  • Schedule and facilitate migration waves, change windows, and cutover activities with cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain clear documentation, status reports, and decision logs.
  • Global stakeholder engagement:
  • Serve as a central point of contact across global infrastructure, network, security, application, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate with the co-managed data center provider at the comanaged location and relevant third-party vendors.
  • Organize and lead recurring standups, working sessions, and steering updates; capture and distribute minutes and action items.
  • Escalate blockers to the appropriate leadership and functional teams with context and recommended next steps.
  • Infrastructure and network support:
  • Support day-to-day infrastructure and network-related activities tied to the migration (e.g., change coordination, maintenance scheduling, access requests).
  • Coordinate network changes, including VLANs, routing updates, firewall rule requests, WAN/Internet transitions, and load balancer configurations as directed by SMEs.
  • Help track capacity planning inputs (compute, storage, network bandwidth) and ensure alignment with target-state designs.
  • Assist in validating connectivity, performance baselines, and post-migration health checks with monitoring teams.
  • Governance, compliance, and change management:
  • Ensure changes follow change control processes, maintenance windows, and communication protocols.
  • Coordinate audit-ready documentation for migrations, including approvals, test results, and backout plans.
  • Partner with security and compliance teams on control requirements, access provisioning, and data handling policies.
  • Cutover and hypercare support:
  • Coordinate pre-cutover checkpoints, go/no-go decisions, and stakeholder communications.
  • Track hypercare issues, triage to the right teams, and ensure timely resolution and handoff to steady-state operations.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to playbooks for subsequent migration waves.
Communication and reporting:
  • Maintain dashboards, trackers, and concise status updates for technical teams and leadership.
  • Provide clear escalation paths, SLAs/ETAs, and communication cadences across time zones.
  • Keep project artifacts current in the designated PM and documentation tools.
  • Vendor and contract coordination:
  • Liaise with co-location and managed service providers for circuit turn-ups, cross-connects, racking/stacking schedules, remote hands, and logistics.
  • Track vendor deliverables and dependencies; escalate variances proactively.
  • Logistics and asset coordination:
  • Support shipment, receiving, and chain-of-custody processes for hardware moves.
  • Coordinate decommissioning, data sanitization workflows, and disposal certificates for retired assets.
  • Quality and risk management:
    • Assist with test plans for application and infrastructure validation (connectivity, performance, failover).
    • Monitor risk indicators (timeline slippage, capacity shortfalls, change collisions) and raise timely alerts.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience coordinating data center or large-scale infrastructure migrations in a co-managed or hybrid environment.
  • Familiarity with core infrastructure concepts: servers/virtualization, storage, networking (routing, switching, firewalls, load balancers), DNS, and monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with project coordination tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, or similar).
  • Strong meeting facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work across global time zones and manage competing priorities.

Nice to Have:
  • Exposure to disaster recovery planning, backup/restore coordination, and business continuity exercises.
  • Understanding of change management frameworks and ITIL concepts.
  • Experience with inventory discovery tools and CMDB hygiene efforts.
Success Indicators:
  • On-time delivery of migration milestones with minimal incidents.
  • Clear, consistent communication and timely escalation of risks/issues.
  • Accurate, audit-ready documentation and repeatable runbooks for each migration wave.
  • Smooth handoffs from project to operations and measurable reduction in post-migration issues.
